verdict.rationale: Missive publishes a full REST API endpoint reference with per-endpoint example requests against its /v1 base URL. Those examples can be copied and run, and every page is also served as Markdown plus an llms.txt index for AI tools. However, the docs explicitly note there is no live try-it runner, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, so the reference is static rather than interactive. missing for 10: an in-browser interactive try-it console, executable runnable examples within the docs, an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Complete reference for Missive API endpoints: analytics, conversations, drafts, posts, contacts, labels, and more
Markdown versions of documentation pages are available by appending `.md` to page URLs
